title: The Hugging Face token now routes through OpenRouter.
friendlyTitle: Your Hugging Face token now chooses a provider for you.
summary: On 16 November, Hugging Face switched language-model calls on Inference Providers from its own router to OpenRouter. The same token still works, through OpenAI-style or Anthropic-style APIs, and OpenRouter picks a provider by live price, speed, and reliability, then retries another if the first fails.
friendlySummary: On 16 November, Hugging Face started sending language-model requests through OpenRouter. You keep the same token and the same code. OpenRouter picks a provider for each call based on price, speed, and whether it is working, and it tries another if the first one fails.
whyItMatters: Your code does not have to change, but the machine behind a call can. Hugging Face cites OpenRouter figures that open-weight models were 71.7% of tokens served by the end of September 2026, at about four times less than closed models on average. A retry is not a fact check.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This can make open models easier to run, and cheaper on average. It does not check the answer. If the provider changes, you still have to read what came back.
